import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', 
                           size='Daily Steps', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.6, palette='deep')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep by Gender and Daily Steps', fontsize=16)

plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=14)
